scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8407 --reload
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:check: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini check
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests
scripts.generate:api: uv run --project apps/api python apps/api/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @ev-chargeops/api-client generate
scripts.check:api-contract: pnpm generate:api && git diff --exit-code HEAD -- packages/api-client/openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint:api && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:integration && pnpm db:check && pnpm check:api-contract && pnpm test:api-client && pnpm typecheck:api-client && pnpm lint:web && pnpm --dir apps/web exec next build --webpack && pnpm test:web
